strategies.name: Fused metadata collection with payload reduction
strategies.desc: Bundle the scalar factors (block means) for all 8 blocks into a separate small all-reduce tensor (size 8), allowing the main data all-reduce to be computed with locally-cached scaling factors, then broadcast corrections. Uses 2-3 all-reduce operations per iteration by separating metadata aggregation from data aggregation, reducing total dispatches to ~16-24 at the cost of two-phase synchronization per iteration.

strategies.name: Ring-based hierarchical reduction with progressive refinement
strategies.desc: Replace all-reduce with reduce-scatter followed by all-gather pattern for each iteration, computing scaling factors on scattered chunks locally and refining incrementally. Approximately 16 collective dispatches (2 per iteration × 8 iterations) but exposes chunk-level parallelism and reduces congestion by splitting reduction and broadcast phases explicitly.

strategies.name: Pipelined overlapping with asynchronous dispatch
strategies.desc:
Launch all 8 all-reduce operations asynchronously with dependency tokens, computing scaling factors eagerly as soon as partial results are available, and overlapping communication of iteration i+1 with computation of iteration i. Still requires 8+ dispatches but hides latency through async overlap; represents latency-hiding over dispatch-count optimization.
